QuestInfo.name: Star of Maple World
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1052121##k, the CEO of Big Hit Records, has something to tell you. Maybe a new record deal?
QuestInfo.1: #p1052121# INSISTS that you're the person she's been looking for. She wants to see you at the Henesys Market.\r\n\r\nTip: Lana is by the hair salon in the Henesys Market.
QuestInfo.2: #p1052121# was sure you had what it took to be a star! Even after you turned her down, #p1052121# suggested you take acting lessons. After all, you could always change your mind!

0.0: You must be... #h0#? Oh, thank goodness! Hello. I'm #p1052121#, the CEO of Big Hit Records. I didn't mean to startle you. My talent scout saw you, and insisted I contact you.
0.1: I can see what my scout saw in you. We've been looking for someone just like you! When you have some time, please come see me in #bHenesys#k. We should definitely have a face-to-face...

yes.0: I'm by the Henesys Market hair salon.

no.0: No? Did you really say no? Please, think about it. Big Hit Records can make you a star...

1.0: You came! My scout was right! Big Hit Records has been looking for you. Are you ready to be a celebrity, #h0#?\r\n#L0##bC-celebrity? Me? This is all so sudden!#l\n#k
1.1: Of course, you're surprised. But the people of Maple World will love you! What do you think? Why don't you give up that weapon and walk the path of the star?\r\n#L0##bAh... But I don't want to stop adventuring... #l\n#k
1.2: Adventuring...I see. That's too bad. You'd be much more suited to acting... Well, even if we don't sign you, would you be willing to consider a proposal?

yes.0: You don't have to become a star right away. Just take some #bacting classes#k here and there. It wouldn't hurt, and if you ever change your mind, you'll be ready!
